name: da-v2-small-metric
role: Multi-terrain fine-tuned metric nDSM model (Phase 5 Concept C / Tier H)
architecture: Depth Anything V2 Small: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 encoder, DPT decoder, features=64, out_channels=[48,96,192,384]
training_domain: Multi-terrain remote sensing (GAMUS urban + swisstopo alpine/hilly + USGS 3DEP LiDAR)
output_semantics: Metric height above local ground in metres (nDSM >= 0.0m) at canonical GSD with edge-preserving vertical step boundaries.
known_limitations_evidence: Height values are relative to local ground (nDSM); absolute elevation requires Tier T terrain layer from coarse DEM.
First-surface model (canopy top, roof top); cannot see ground under dense forest canopy.
Trained on 0.33m-1.0m nadir imagery; accuracy may degrade on extreme off-nadir oblique views (>30 deg).
